note: Scripture authority for Arabic is Smith–Van Dyck (1865), the language's Bible in language_seed.py. The whole text (vowelled, 31,104 verses) was taken from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/arb_vdv, ebible id arb-vd — public domain) and every quotation marked verbatim was pasted from it by script.

A `mined` row means the finished text contains at least 20 characters of that verse's Van Dyck wording byte-for-byte (measured, not claimed). Quotations the author adapts or re-personalises are self_rendered and written without vowel marks, so a reader can tell them from pasted Van Dyck.
